name: Harding-Lee & Company
brand_truth: A senior, boutique Bahamian law practice on two islands, Nassau and Salt Pond, Long Island, since 1996.

design.signature: Hairline drawing of New Providence and Long Island joined by a thread, reused as a clickable office switcher; matter-to-attorney selector

current_site_findings: The homepage opens with 'Welcome To' and one long paragraph; no clear way to reach a specific attorney.
The associate's surname differs between the About page (Adderley) and the Contact page (Johnson).
Forty years of practice and the Bank of The Bahamas chairmanship are buried in an inner page.
Not updated since July 2022; pages titled 'Front page' with ?page_id= URLs.
No addresses or maps on the homepage; the Long Island office is barely visible.
pitch_line: Clients in Long Island and overseas cannot tell from your site which of you to call or where your Salt Pond office is; this concept routes each matter to the right attorney in two taps.
assumptions: Associate named Nadia Hope Johnson (About page says Adderley)
One-line practice-area descriptions are restatements of published areas
Partner's email used as the main enquiry address
notes: Record said no site listed, but hardinglee.com is live (last updated July 2022): treated as Track A, outdated. No hours published, so none shown. Portraits hotlinked from their own site. Islands drawing labelled illustration, not to scale.
